How DriveCore handles information submitted through this website.

We may collect information you voluntarily submit through contact or booking forms, including your name, phone number, email address, vehicle details, preferred service date and description of the vehicle concern.
Information is used to respond to enquiries, discuss requested services, arrange appointments, provide customer support and maintain records related to your request.

The website platform may process basic technical information needed for security, performance and normal operation. Any analytics or marketing tools added later should be reviewed and reflected in this policy.

DriveCore does not sell personal information. Information may be shared only with service providers supporting normal business operations, when required to complete a requested service, or when required by law.
Reasonable administrative and technical measures are used to protect submitted information. No internet transmission or electronic storage system can be guaranteed completely secure.
Information may be retained for as long as reasonably necessary to manage the enquiry, appointment, customer relationship, legal obligations and business records.
You may contact DriveCore to request correction or deletion of information you previously submitted, subject to legal and legitimate record requirements.
